translations.web: Your laws remain to this day, for all things serve you.
translations.bsb: Your ordinances stand to this day, for all things are servants to You.
translations.kjv: They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all are thy servants.
translations.asv: They abide this day according to thine ordinances; For all things are thy servants.
